note: Twenty-five source-backed research entries. Clinical findings are kept scoped to the tested preparation, population, and outcome; mechanistic language is not promoted beyond the cited evidence.

source.title: An Examination into the Anti-stress and Anti-fatigue Effects of an Ashwagandha Extract (Ashwa.30™) in Stressed Adults: A Randomised, Double-Blind, Placebo-controlled Trial

ashwagandha.finding: A 28-day randomized placebo-controlled trial in 60 stressed adults found a low-dose ashwagandha extract was associated with changes in perceived stress, mood, fatigue and stress-reactivity outcomes.

source.title: Crocus sativus L. in the treatment of mild to moderate depression: a double-blind, randomized and placebo-controlled trial

saffron.finding: A six-week randomized placebo-controlled trial reported improvement in mild-to-moderate depressive symptoms with Crocus sativus stigma extract versus placebo.

source.title: Attenuation of laboratory-induced stress in humans after acute administration of Melissa officinalis (Lemon Balm)

lemon-balm.finding: A randomized human laboratory study found acute Melissa officinalis administration altered responses to experimentally induced psychological stress.

source.title: Passionflower in the treatment of generalized anxiety: a pilot double-blind randomized controlled trial with oxazepam

passionflower.finding: In a small randomized trial of adults with generalized anxiety disorder, Passiflora incarnata extract produced anxiety improvement comparable to oxazepam over four weeks, with slower onset noted for passionflower.

source.title: Standardized Extract of Valeriana officinalis Improves Overall Sleep Quality in Human Subjects with Sleep Complaints: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Clinical Study

valerian.finding: An eight-week randomized placebo-controlled clinical study found standardized Valeriana officinalis extract improved several subjective and objective sleep measures in adults with sleep complaints.

source.title: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group study of the standardised extract SHR-5 of the roots of Rhodiola rosea in the treatment of subjects with stress-related fatigue

rhodiola.finding: A randomized placebo-controlled trial evaluated standardized Rhodiola rosea extract in people with stress-related fatigue and reported improvement in fatigue-related outcomes.

source.title: The Effects of a Bacopa monnieri Extract (Bacumen®) on Cognition, Stress, and Fatigue in Healthy Adults: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial

bacopa-monnieri.finding: A 12-week randomized placebo-controlled trial in 101 adults evaluated 300 mg/day Bacopa monnieri extract for cognition, stress and fatigue, providing direct human evidence for this preparation.

source.title: Cognition enhancing effect of panax ginseng in Korean volunteers with mild cognitive impairment: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial

panax-ginseng.finding: A randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 90 Korean volunteers with mild cognitive impairment investigated cognition after Panax ginseng supplementation and reported cognition-related benefits.

source.title: Effects of L-Theanine Administration on Stress-Related Symptoms and Cognitive Functions in Healthy Adults: A Randomized Controlled Trial

l-theanine.finding: In a four-week randomized placebo-controlled crossover trial, 200 mg/day L-theanine reduced several stress-related measures and improved selected cognitive outcomes.

source.title: Magnesium Bisglycinate Supplementation in Healthy Adults Reporting Poor Sleep: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial

magnesium-bisglycinate.finding: A randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 155 adults with self-reported poor sleep tested 250 mg/day elemental magnesium as bisglycinate against placebo for insomnia symptoms.

source.title: Efficacy of melatonin for sleep disturbance in middle-aged primary insomnia: a double-blind, randomised clinical trial

melatonin.finding: A randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial found four weeks of 3 mg fast-release melatonin improved sleep-related outcomes in middle-aged adults with primary insomnia.

source.title: Lavender oil preparation Silexan is effective in generalized anxiety disorder--a randomized, double-blind comparison to placebo and paroxetine

lavender.finding: A 10-week randomized double-blind trial in 539 adults with generalized anxiety disorder found 80 or 160 mg/day Silexan reduced anxiety symptoms versus placebo.

source.title: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of oral Matricaria recutita (chamomile) extract therapy for generalized anxiety disorder

chamomile.finding: A randomized placebo-controlled trial evaluated Matricaria recutita extract in adults with mild-to-moderate generalized anxiety disorder and reported anxiety-related clinical outcomes.

source.title: Curcumin for the treatment of major depression: a randomised, double-blind, placebo controlled study

curcumin.finding: An eight-week randomized double-blind placebo-controlled study in 56 people with major depressive disorder tested curcumin 500 mg twice daily and assessed depressive symptoms.

source.title: The efficacy of omega-3 supplementation for major depression: a randomized controlled trial

omega-3.finding: In a large randomized trial of adults with major depressive episodes, the overall primary analysis showed only a trend toward benefit, while a prespecified subgroup without comorbid anxiety showed significant improvement; this is therefore not a uniform antidepressant effect.

source.title: A randomized, double-blind placebo-controlled trial of oral creatine monohydrate augmentation for enhanced response to a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor in women with major depressive disorder

creatine.finding: An eight-week randomized placebo-controlled trial found creatine augmentation of escitalopram improved depressive outcomes in women with major depressive disorder compared with escitalopram plus placebo.

source.title: A soy-based phosphatidylserine/phosphatidic acid complex normalizes the stress reactivity of hypothalamus-pituitary-adrenal-axis in chronically stressed male subjects: a randomized, placebo-controlled study

phosphatidylserine.finding: A randomized placebo-controlled study in chronically stressed men found a phosphatidylserine/phosphatidic-acid complex altered HPA-axis stress reactivity.

source.title: Effects of a tart cherry juice beverage on the sleep of older adults with insomnia: a pilot study

tart-cherry.finding: A small randomized double-blind crossover pilot in older adults with chronic insomnia found some improvements in insomnia severity and sleep variables with a tart-cherry beverage, but several objective sleep outcomes did not differ from placebo.

source.title: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial investigating the effects of an Ocimum tenuiflorum (Holy Basil) extract (HolixerTM) on stress, mood, and sleep in adults experiencing stress

holy-basil.finding: An eight-week randomized placebo-controlled trial in 100 adults experiencing stress found standardized Ocimum tenuiflorum extract improved perceived stress and subjective sleep measures and reduced several stress biomarkers.

source.title: Short-term study on the effects of rosemary on cognitive function in an elderly population

rosemary.finding: A randomized crossover study in 28 older adults found a dose-dependent effect of dried rosemary leaf powder on speed of memory, with benefit at 750 mg but impairment at the highest tested dose.

source.title: The Acute and Chronic Cognitive Effects of a Sage Extract: A Randomized, Placebo Controlled Study in Healthy Humans

sage.finding: A randomized placebo-controlled study of 94 healthy adults found a standardized sage combination produced consistent benefits on several working-memory and accuracy tasks acutely and after 29 days.

source.title: A double-blind, placebo-controlled study on the effects of Gotu Kola (Centella asiatica) on acoustic startle response in healthy subjects

gotu-kola.finding: A small double-blind placebo-controlled human study found a single oral dose of Centella asiatica attenuated acoustic startle response, supporting a preliminary anxiolytic signal but not clinical treatment efficacy.

source.title: Consumption of cocoa flavanols results in acute improvements in mood and cognitive performance during sustained mental effort

cocoa-flavanols.finding: A randomized double-blind crossover study in healthy adults found acute cocoa-flavanol consumption affected mood and selected cognitive-performance measures during sustained mental effort.

source.title: Green tea extract enhances parieto-frontal connectivity during working memory processing

green-tea-extract.finding: A double-blind within-subject human neuroimaging study found green tea extract increased working-memory-related effective connectivity between parietal and frontal brain regions; this is a mechanistic neural signal rather than proof of clinical cognitive benefit.

source.title: A combination of green tea extract and l-theanine improves memory and attention in subjects with mild cognitive impairment: a double-blind placebo-controlled study

green-tea-l-theanine-combination.finding: A 16-week randomized placebo-controlled trial of a green-tea-extract/L-theanine combination in mild cognitive impairment found signals for improved memory and selective attention in a prespecified lower-MMSE subgroup.
